name: Halbestunde AltStore Source
subtitle: Clean minimal iOS sheet music scanner & audio player
description: Scan printed or digital piano sheet music with Optical Music Recognition (OMR) and listen with pure native iOS audio playback, minimal score preview, and distraction-free design inspired by Feather.

apps.name: Halbestunde
apps.versionDescription:
Initial v1.0.0 Release:
• Liquid Glass (Glassmorphism) UI with .ultraThinMaterial and specular rim glows
• Camera sheet music scanner with Optical Music Recognition (OMR)
• Physical modeling polyphonic acoustic grand piano audio engine
• Interactive score canvas with synchronized animated playhead
• 61/88-key lighted virtual piano keyboard with dual-hand color cues
• Practice suite: A-B looping, tempo slider (40-240 BPM), transposition, LH/RH isolation
• Preloaded classical repertoire (Für Elise, Moonlight Sonata, Minuet in G, Chopin Nocturne)
apps.localizedDescription: Halbestunde turns sheet music into playable audio with Apple Vision OMR and native audio playback in a distraction-free, minimal iOS interface.
